subject: gk
question: Who among the following is NOT part of the Goods and Services Tax Council of India?

options.text: Union Minister of State in charge of Revenue or Finance
The Minister in-charge of Finance of each state or any other minister nominated by state government

solution:
The correct answer is __**Lieutenant Governors of Union Territories**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• As per Article 279A of the amended Constitution, the GST Council shall consist of the following members: -
 
 
• The Union Finance Minister - Chairperson;
 
• The Union Minister of State in charge of Revenue or Finance- Member.
 
• The Minister in charge of Finance or Taxation or any other Minister nominated by each State Government -Members.
 
 
 
• It is the key decision-making authority regarding GST.
 
• Centre has 1/3rd voting rights and states have 2/3rd voting rights.
 
• GST was enforced with effect from 1st July 2017.
 
• The Goods and Service Tax Council comprises the Union Finance Minister, the Minister of State(Revenue), and the State Finance Ministers to recommend the GST rate, exemption, thresholds, taxes to be subsumed, etc.
 
• **Lieutenant Governors of Union Territories** is NOT part of the Goods and Services Tax Council of India.
